projects.name: Better Canvas
projects.pitch: A read-only Canvas dashboard that answers one question: what do I do next?
blurb: Lists everything due in the next 14 days, from overdue to later.
Puts the next deadline on one red note with a live countdown.
Shows how a score on any assignment would move your grade.

media.alt: Better Canvas in its Typewriter theme on demo data: a red note for a late assignment beside a list of what is due.

projects.name: Desk
projects.pitch: A desk app that turns your calendar, Canvas and notes into one calm plan for today.
blurb: Pulls classes and due dates from your calendar, Canvas and notes.
Picks what to work on next and runs a 45-minute focus timer.
Turns finished work into XP, quests and boss fights.

media.alt: Desk's Today page on a made-up student's data: the date, a timeline of the day, two suggestions for what to do next and a list of tasks.

projects.name: Fab Run
projects.pitch: A web game about how a chip gets made, and who makes it.
blurb: Hands you one wafer and a chip factory to run it through.
Starts at deposition, where your call sets the film thickness.
Shows the real job behind the station. Four more stations are planned.

media.alt: Fab Run on a phone, at the deposition station: a diagram of film building up on a wafer and a question about how long to run the tool.
